non_goals: Restating common governance, role or skill policy that its owner already states.
Adding a rule, permission or command beyond the owning policy, approval and safety documents.
The Claude import files named CLAUDE.md, which stay native and carry no common role.
template_definition.applicability: Every AGENTS.md outside docs/98.archive/, the repository root file and the folder files, and its template.

positive: Each AGENTS.md and the template pass the form tree, table, author-prompt, residue and agent-governance checks.
An AGENTS.md whose Tool Rules table keeps the registered columns, or whose Tool Rules table has a header only, passes the document table check.
negative: A reordered, missing or extra Tool Rules column fails BODY-TABLE-COLUMNS.
A table section outside the form fails REGISTRY_TABLE_SECTION.
A source profile named by two template twins that carry tables fails REGISTRY_TABLE_TWIN.
A root gateway over 30 content lines or 16 heading lines fails AGENT-NATIVE-REFERENCE.
regression: The AGENTS profiles stay native and keep empty heading lists; an empty section is a review matter.
tests/test_common_form_tree.py asserts exactly the forms and definitions the repository registry carries.

extensions.condition: Applies when repository work changes Kubernetes manifests, GitOps structure, cluster bootstrap or an external-service contract, procedures the shared contract does not define.

extensions.name: Task Table/frontmatter summary
extensions.condition: Applies to every Task: one Task Table and one frontmatter status marker, with the marker derived from the rows of a multi-row Task.
extensions.verification: tests/test_task_summary_derivation.py and the strict Markdown profile check of the sdlc/task profile, both run by the document suite of scripts/run-contract-tests.py.
extensions.review: When the sdlc/task body contract or its task_execution binding changes, and when shared_contract.version changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition defines the Task summary derivation or the registry drops the sdlc/task task_execution binding.

extensions.name: Registry document_language, Korean-allowed common agent Markdown, and Codex/Claude native syntax

extensions.verification: tests/test_document_language.py, the REGISTRY_DOCUMENT_LANGUAGE registry check and the strict Markdown profile check.
extensions.review: When document_language changes and when shared_contract.version changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition defines the document language contract or document_language leaves the registry.

extensions.name: Local candidate Task first-recording of observed draft, ready, in-progress, or blocked state
extensions.condition: Applies when a new Task's first Git version records an observed nonterminal ready, in-progress or blocked row, under a scoped user request and Task Inputs that name its owner, prerequisites and evidence.
extensions.verification: tests/test_shared_contract_binding.py, the REGISTRY_LIFECYCLE_DOMAIN check of the Task initial states, and python3 scripts/validate-document-lifecycle.py --root . --mode staged.
extensions.review: When shared_contract.version changes and when the task lifecycle domain changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition admits a nonterminal first-recording state for a Task, or Task creation returns to draft only.

extensions.name: Local candidate Spec/Plan direct draft-to-approved transition after actual batch review and approval
extensions.condition: Applies when a scoped user request, an actual batch review and the user's approval are recorded before a Spec and Plan move from draft to approved.
extensions.verification: tests/test_shared_contract_binding.py, the REGISTRY_LIFECYCLE_DOMAIN check that the spec-plan draft-to-approved edge exists exactly when this extension is declared, and the staged lifecycle check.
extensions.review: When shared_contract.version changes and when the spec-plan lifecycle domain changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition admits the direct draft-to-approved transition, or Spec and Plan approval returns to a separate commit after draft.

extensions.name: Local candidate Spec/Plan first-recording as approved after actual batch review and approval
extensions.condition: Applies when a scoped request, an actual batch review and the user's approval precede the first Git record, which then holds the same-package Spec and Plan at approved with the Task Evidence review and approval receipt.
extensions.verification: tests/test_shared_contract_binding.py and the staged lifecycle check, which reads the review and approval receipt rows of the Task.
extensions.review: When shared_contract.version changes and when the spec-plan lifecycle domain changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition admits a first record at approved, or Spec and Plan first records return to draft only.

extensions.name: Advisory shared workspace-memory SQLite store with Task and repository authority
extensions.condition: Applies when an agent keeps reusable context in the shared workspace memory store at .workspace-memory/memory.sqlite3, which stays advisory and never replaces Task or repository authority.
extensions.verification: tests/test_workspace_memory.py, run through the workspace-memory-regressions check in scripts/validation/registry.json.
extensions.review: When .agents/governance/context-and-memory.md or scripts/workspace_memory.py changes, and when shared_contract.version changes.
extensions.removal: When the memory store is retired or a shared WGOV-CORE edition defines its own memory store.

extensions.name: Rules table Status column for retired policy rules
extensions.condition: Applies to every Rules table of this repository: a rule ID is never reused until a user-approved new baseline under the Q-07 contract and a retired rule keeps its row, so the table carries an optional Status column whose value is active, or retired; followed by a successor rule ID or none.
extensions.verification: POLICY-RULE-TABLE in the strict Markdown profile check and tests/test_policy_rule_ids.py, run by the document suite of scripts/run-contract-tests.py.
extensions.review: When shared_contract.version changes and when the Rules table definition of the Policy TemplateDefinitions changes.
extensions.removal: When a shared WGOV-CORE edition of the Policy form defines rule retirement, when the user ends no-reuse retirement for rule IDs, or at a user-approved new baseline under the Q-07 contract.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Names the document for readers and owner-key derivation.

frontmatter_keys.lifecycle: Set when the document is created; changed when its subject is renamed.

frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Names the document type, which equals the profile that governs the document.

frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Places the document in its lifecycle state.
frontmatter_keys.data_type: string from the profile status domain
frontmatter_keys.lifecycle: Starts at the profile's initial state and moves along the lifecycle domain's transitions.
frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Names the party accountable for the document.
frontmatter_keys.lifecycle: Set when the document is created; changed when accountability moves.
frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Dates the last content change.

frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Gives a document a stable identity other documents link to.

frontmatter_keys.duplicate_source: The number in the document path.
frontmatter_keys.lifecycle: Assigned when the document is created from its path; never reused.
frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.lifecycle: Added when a document replaces an earlier one.
frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.purpose: Names the later document or documents that replace this document.

frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

frontmatter_keys.migration: Removed from every other document by SPEC-0184 (W03-D22, W03-H25); an accepted ADR keeps it until a successor replaces it.

frontmatter_keys.migration: None recorded; the key keeps its meaning and no package changes it.

relation_kinds.meaning: A document or template names the policy owner whose rule it applies.
relation_kinds.owner: The source document author; the policy owner never lists its dependents.

relation_kinds.meaning: A child document names the one parent that owns it.
relation_kinds.owner: The child's frontmatter parent_ids, derived from the package path.

relation_kinds.meaning: A document names the design decision or description that limits it.
relation_kinds.owner: The author of the constrained document.

relation_kinds.meaning: A document names the requirement it derives from or the criterion it verifies.
relation_kinds.owner: The author of the downstream document.

relation_kinds.meaning: A Plan names the current owner that receives each durable contract.
relation_kinds.owner: The Plan author; the current owner holds the content and the Task holds the receipt.

relation_kinds.meaning: A successor names its predecessor, and where the lifecycle domain has a superseded state the predecessor names its successor in the same commit.
relation_kinds.owner: The successor author; an accepted ADR is never edited, so its successor alone carries the relation.

relation_kinds.meaning: A frontmatter key or a TemplateDefinition names the paths that must change with it.
relation_kinds.owner: The registry entry of the key or of the definition.

relations.reverse_view: Derived by scripts/document-backlinks.py; the parent never lists its children.
gaps: The i-th source profile is owned by the i-th target profile. A Spec carries no parent_ids, so the root of the ownership forest has no owner entry.

relations.reverse_view: Derived by scripts/document-backlinks.py; the Requirement Downstream owner column is a reciprocal carrier that current checks require. SPEC-0195 keeps it unchanged; the Architecture form package (SPEC-0197) completes the citing Upstream requirement rows, then removes the column and replaces its link check with a derived coverage check (W03-D55).
gaps: BODY-LINK-SOURCE and BODY-LINK-SOURCE-PROFILE are formed at run time from the link direction and cannot be named by occurrence; the negative test exercises BODY-LINK-SOURCE-PROFILE.

relations.reverse_view: Derived by scripts/document-backlinks.py; a constraint is never a second parent.
gaps: The Spec Architecture column is not a link column of the body contract, so no rule checks its links (W03-D51).
BODY-LINK-SOURCE and BODY-LINK-SOURCE-PROFILE are formed at run time from the link direction and cannot be named by occurrence.

relations.reverse_view: None: the current owner holds the content and the Task holds the receipt.
gaps: The Plan Promotion table is read by a script and not by a body contract; the Plan form package changes this entry with the reader (W03-H10).

relations.reverse_view: superseded_by, written with the successor in one commit where the lifecycle domain has a superseded state; an accepted ADR is never edited, so its successor alone carries the relation.
gaps: The cycle observation walks artifact identifiers; an identifier that names no document in the tree is not itself refused.

No changed-file rule compares a criterion identifier with the criteria its parent Spec defines; the link path is checked by BODY-LINK-BROKEN and its fragment by LINK-FRAGMENT, and the completion mode compares the Plan allocations.

relations.reverse_view: None: a policy owner never lists the templates that apply it.
gaps: No rule checks that a policy_refs path exists.

relations.reverse_view: Read from the registry entry; scripts/validate-affected-surfaces.py maps a changed path to its validators. The consumer_paths of a frontmatter key are checked by REGISTRY_KEY_CONSUMER and REGISTRY_KEY_TEST (SPEC-0181).
gaps: The consumer_paths of a TemplateDefinition are not checked for existence.

link_types.meaning: Names the current owner whose rule applies, by its identity and, where the owner is versioned, the version or scope that applies; its target is a current document, never history.
link_types.pinning: The owner's identity, and its version or scope where it is versioned.

link_types.meaning: Pins what was observed: the revision, the input, the result and the location.
link_types.pinning: Revision, input, result and location of the observation.
gaps: Only that a cell is concrete is checked, not that the location resolves.

link_types.meaning: Names a commit:path or an Archived Lineage row for recovery and is marked non-authoritative.
link_types.pinning: The commit and the path that recover the past content.
gaps: Reachability of a commit:path reference stays a manual review (ADR-0056 Decision 6).

link_types.meaning: Promises only that the path and the anchor exist.
link_types.pinning: The path and the anchor of the target.
gaps: A fragment into a non-Markdown file or into docs/98.archive/ is not checked.
